en.text:
Passively grants #e${50+#d} Blast Radius.

Rockets attach on impact and detonate after 3 seconds, dealing 35% increased <bold Explosive Damage />.

Due to the split of impact and explosive damage on Rocket Launchers, this perk only provides an overall increase of 26-27% damage for the sake of boss DPS.

Does not buff the damage of <yellow Wolfpack Rounds />.

enhanced (
var d = 5
#e Grants 5 more Blast Radius passively.
)
